details: Hybrid solar inverter (HSI series), toroidal transformer
Output: 220 V AC pure sine wave, 50/60 Hz automatic recognition
AC input range: 165-275 V AC; regulation on battery: 220 V AC ±3 %
Battery types: Gel, SLA, AGM, flooded
Charge voltage: 13.8 V (12 V) / 27.6 V (24 V)
Solar charger: 30 A PWM; PV up to 25 V open circuit / 450 W (12 V), 50 V / 900 W (24 V)
Total charging current: up to 45 A
Modes: AC mains priority, ECO, DC battery priority
